text: Error Knowledge Base（DSH 插件，DSH 客户端）：把 DSH 中观察到的工具、命令、agent 和模型请求失败接入本机 errkb 核心，通过本地 Named Pipe 记录并查询已保存的问题与解法。插件可在后续步骤注入已知修复提示，提供会话摘要，并通过五个工具查找、记录、列出、标记不再适用的问题和查看统计；核心不可用时会暂存观测并在恢复后重放。适合希望在开发会话中复用已验证错误解法的用户。需要本机运行 errkb 核心及其 PostgreSQL 环境。

Error Knowledge Base is a DSH plugin that forwards observed failures to the local errkb core over a Named Pipe. It injects saved fix notices and offers five tools to search, record, list, mark, and report errors. It queues observations during outages. Requires the local core and PostgreSQL.

dsh-errkb README · Error Knowledge Base：[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) · [License](LICENSE)

> **Diagnose an error once, record the fix, and reuse it the next time the same failure appears — locally, without calling a model.**

Error Knowledge Base (`errkb`) is a local error-reuse and prevention platform for command-line workflows and AI coding tools. It captures observable failures, stores redacted and deduplicated knowledge in PostgreSQL, returns known fixes with evidence and trust, and tracks repository-backed prevention artifacts.

dsh-errkb README · Release and source status：| Version             | What it contains                                                                                                                              |
| ------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Released v0.1.3** | Error capture, retrieval, versioned fixes, outcomes and trust; CLI, daemon, Web toolbox and connectors; migrations `0001`–`0008`; 9 MCP tools |
| **Current `main`**  | Everything above, plus the prevention loop, recurrence metrics, migration `0009` and 12 MCP tools; tested but not yet released                |

dsh-errkb README · Release and source status：Download the portable toolbox from [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/jingchangzhao-gif/error-knowledge-base/releases/latest). Source-only capabilities are marked **Unreleased** below so the download is not confused with the development branch.

dsh-errkb README · What you can do：| Goal                                | Capability                                                                                                                        |
| ----------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Capture failures                    | Wrap CLI commands, observe supported host hooks, follow logs or submit an `ErrorEvent v1` payload                                 |
| Protect local data                  | Redact secrets before persistence; use a local Named Pipe by default with no telemetry or outbound model calls                    |
| Identify repeats                    | Classify, normalize, fingerprint and deduplicate failures by project; repeated events append occurrences idempotently             |
| Find known fixes                    | Search exact identifiers first, then at most three explicitly labelled approximate candidates                                     |
| Reuse with context                  | Return the stored fix, source, match reason, environment warning and measured trust
dsh-errkb README · What you can do：The exact implementation and verification boundary for each feature is in [`docs/features-and-implementation.md`](docs/features-and-implementation.md).

dsh-errkb README · How it works：```text
CLI / host hook / log / manual event
                │
                ▼
       redact → classify → normalize → fingerprint

dsh-errkb README · How it works：- Only failures are captured by the CLI wrapper; successful commands are not stored.
- Exact fingerprint matches are reusable only when structured fields do not contradict. Approximate matches always require confirmation.
- Fixes come from stored solution versions, not from a model generating a new answer.
- Trust is computed from recorded outcomes; unknown outcomes do not change it.

dsh-errkb README · Requirements：- Windows 10 or 11, x64.
- PostgreSQL 16. errkb manages a dedicated local cluster; the database is not embedded.
- No Go, Node.js or development toolchain is needed to run a release.

dsh-errkb README · Install and open：Unpack `errkb-toolbox.zip` into a writable directory, then run:

```powershell
.\errkb.exe pg install
.\start-errkb.cmd
```

The first command creates the local cluster, applies migrations and writes credentials. The second opens the loopback-only Web toolbox and starts the daemon when needed. For an existing PostgreSQL server, use `errkb db migrate --dsn <your-dsn>` instead.

See [`docs/install.md`](docs/install.md) for custom ports, upgrades, logon recovery and uninstallation.

dsh-errkb README · Complete the first reuse loop：Run a real project command through errkb:

```powershell
.\errkb.exe run --connector cli --session local --project my-repo -- npm test
```

If it fails, open the issue in the Web toolbox and record the verified fix, or use MCP `err_record_solution`. Run the same command again to retrieve that fix when the failure repeats.

Record whether the specific solution version worked:

dsh-errkb README · Complete the first reuse loop：```powershell
.\errkb.exe feedback <issue-id> <solution-version-id> --outcome success
.\errkb.exe search "module not found"
.\errkb.exe show <issue-id>
.\errkb.exe stats

The generic CLI returns a known fix **after** observing the failure. Supported DSH and Claude hooks can additionally provide standing hints or notices before a new diagnosis.

dsh-errkb README · AI host integration：| Host        | Supported integration                                               |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Generic CLI | `errkb run -- <command>` failure capture and known-fix lookup       |
| DSH         | Plugin hooks, standing hints and post-execution notices             |
| Codex CLI   | CLI wrapper and MCP tools; no pre-failure hook is claimed           |
| Claude Code | `PostToolUseFailure` hook, CLI wrapper, session hints and MCP tools |

dsh-errkb README · AI host integration：Register MCP with a supported host:

```powershell
.\errkb.exe mcp install --host codex
.\errkb.exe mcp install --host claude
.\errkb.exe mcp install --host dsh
.\errkb.exe mcp selftest

Current `main` exposes 12 MCP tools; released v0.1.3 exposes 9. MCP lets a model or user actively query and update allowed knowledge; installing it does not passively watch the host. Measured versions and unsupported paths are recorded in [`docs/connector-matrix.md`](docs/connector-matrix.md).

dsh-errkb README · Prevention loop on current `main`：Turn a resolved issue into a reviewed, versioned prevention artifact:

1. Register a repository-relative file and its SHA-256 as a draft.
2. Explicitly run a bounded verification command through the CLI.
3. Commit the artifact yourself, then activate the matching verified version at a clean Git `HEAD`.
4. Observe recurrence through real occurrence data and 30-day activation windows.

dsh-errkb README · Prevention loop on current `main`：```powershell
errkb prevention add --issue <resolved-issue-id> --kind regression_test --title "Rename regression" --repo . --path tests/rename_test.go
errkb prevention verify <artifact-version-id> --repo . -- go test ./...

dsh-errkb README · Review and commit the artifact yourself before activation.：errkb prevention activate <artifact-version-id> --repo .
errkb prevention stats --issue <resolved-issue-id>
```

The four artifact kinds are `regression_test`, `deterministic_check`, `agent_instruction` and `intent`. MCP can register metadata and read preventions, but only the human-invoked CLI can verify or activate them. Web prevention statistics are read-only.

dsh-errkb README · Command overview：Most read and write commands support `--json` with a versioned contract payload.

dsh-errkb README · Privacy and operating boundaries：- Knowledge stays on the local machine. The core makes no model calls, outbound network requests or telemetry reports.
- Redaction happens before database writes. HTTP is off by default; MCP uses stdio and the local API uses an owner-only Named Pipe.
- Prevention storage contains metadata, hashes and redacted bounded evidence, not artifact bodies or absolute repository paths.
- Retention functions and settings exist, but automatic scheduled purging is not currently wired into the daemon.
- The DSH adapter's offline queue can temporarily contain raw observations on local disk before core redaction.
dsh-errkb README · Privacy and operating boundaries：Read [`docs/privacy.md`](docs/privacy.md) before storing sensitive project data.

dsh-errkb README · Current limitations：- PostgreSQL 16 is required; errkb is not a database-embedded single-file application.
- Releases are not code-signed; verify the published `SHA256SUMS`.
- Prevention activation does not automatically integrate an artifact into CI or a host workflow.
- errkb does not generate regression tests, edit prevention files, perform automatic Git writes or execute retrieved fixes.
- There is no team/cloud synchronization, vector search, private chain-of-thought capture or reliable hallucination detector.
- Generic log/manual host acceptance and the connector paths explicitly marked unverified in the matrix remain incomplete.

dsh-errkb README · 错误知识库（Error Knowledge Base）：[English](README.md) · [许可证](LICENSE)

> **同一个错误只诊断一次：记录真实解法，下次失败时直接复用——全程本地完成，不调用模型。**

错误知识库（`errkb`）是面向命令行工作流和 AI 编程工具的本地报错复用与预防平台。它采集可观察的失败，把脱敏、去重后的知识保存到 PostgreSQL，在错误再次出现时返回带证据和可信度的已知解法，并跟踪仓库中的预防产物。
dsh-errkb README · 发布版与源码状态：从 [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/jingchangzhao-gif/error-knowledge-base/releases/latest) 下载便携工具箱。仅存在于源码中的能力会标记为 **Unreleased**，避免把开发分支与下载发布版混为一谈。

dsh-errkb README · 目前能做什么：| 目标                       | 功能                                                                                 |
| -------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 采集失败                   | 包装 CLI 命令、观察受支持宿主的 Hook、跟随日志或提交 `ErrorEvent v1` 载荷            |
| 保护本地数据               | 写库前脱敏；默认使用本地 Named Pipe，没有遥测，也不调用外部模型                      |
| 识别重复错误               | 按项目分类、规范化、计算指纹并去重；重复事件以幂等方式追加 occurrence                |
| 查找已知解法               | 先检索精确标识，再返回最多三个明确标记的近似候选                                     |
| 带上下文复用               | 返回已保存解法、来源、匹配原因、环境警告和实测可信度                                 |
| 从结果中学习               | 保留解法版本，并记录特定版本的成功、失败或未知结果                                   |
| 预防复发（**Unreleased**） | 版本化回归测试、确定性检查、代理指令和意图；验证、激活并测量真实复发                 |
| 本地运维                   | 使用 Web 工具箱、MCP、诊断、迁移、备份恢复、保留策略、审计删除和便携 PostgreSQL 管理 |

CLI / 宿主 Hook / 日志 / 手工事件
                │
                ▼
       脱敏 → 分类 → 规范化 → 指纹

- CLI 包装器只采集失败，成功命令不会入库。
- 只有结构化字段不矛盾的精确指纹匹配才可复用；近似匹配始终需要人工确认。
- 解法来自已保存的解法版本，不是模型临时生成的新答案。
- 可信度根据真实结果计算，未知结果不会改变分数。

dsh-errkb README · 环境要求：- Windows 10 或 11，x64。
- PostgreSQL 16。errkb 管理专用本地实例，数据库不内嵌。
- 运行发布版不需要 Go、Node.js 或其他开发工具链。

dsh-errkb README · 安装并打开：把 `errkb-toolbox.zip` 解压到有写权限的目录，然后运行：

```powershell
.\errkb.exe pg install
.\start-errkb.cmd
```

第一条命令创建本地实例、应用迁移并写入凭据；第二条打开仅监听回环地址的 Web 工具箱，并在需要时启动后台服务。若要复用已有 PostgreSQL，改用 `errkb db migrate --dsn <你的 DSN>`。

自定义端口、升级、登录恢复和卸载见 [`docs/install.zh-CN.md`](docs/install.zh-CN.md)。

dsh-errkb README · 完成第一次报错复用：用 errkb 运行一个真实项目命令：

```powershell
.\errkb.exe run --connector cli --session local --project my-repo -- npm test
```

如果失败，在 Web 工具箱中打开该问题并记录已验证解法，或者使用 MCP `err_record_solution`。相同失败再次出现时，重新运行该命令即可取回解法。

记录这个解法版本是否有效：

```powershell
.\errkb.exe feedback <issue-id> <solution-version-id> --outcome success
.\errkb.exe search "module not found"
.\errkb.exe show <issue-id>
.\errkb.exe stats

通用 CLI 是在**观察到失败之后**返回已知解法。受支持的 DSH 和 Claude Hook 还可以在新诊断前提供常驻提示或通知。

| Codex CLI   | CLI 包装器和 MCP 工具；不宣称具有失败前 Hook               |

dsh-errkb README · 接入 AI 宿主：```powershell
.\errkb.exe mcp install --host codex
.\errkb.exe mcp install --host claude
.\errkb.exe mcp install --host dsh

当前 `main` 提供 12 个 MCP 工具，已发布的 v0.1.3 提供 9 个。MCP 允许模型或用户主动查询及更新获准的知识；只安装 MCP 不会被动监视宿主。实测版本与未支持路径见 [`docs/connector-matrix.zh-CN.md`](docs/connector-matrix.zh-CN.md)。

dsh-errkb README · 当前 `main` 的预防闭环：把一个已解决问题转化为经过审查、可版本化的预防产物：

1. 登记仓库相对路径及其 SHA-256，创建草稿。
2. 通过 CLI 显式运行一个有界验证命令。
3. 由你提交产物，再在干净 Git `HEAD` 上激活匹配的已验证版本。
4. 根据真实 occurrence 和激活前后 30 天窗口观察复发。

```powershell
errkb prevention add --issue <已解决-issue-id> --kind regression_test --title "Rename regression" --repo . --path tests/rename_test.go
errkb prevention verify <artifact-version-id> --repo . -- go test ./...

dsh-errkb README · 激活前由你审查并提交产物。：errkb prevention activate <artifact-version-id> --repo .
errkb prevention stats --issue <已解决-issue-id>
```

四种产物类型为 `regression_test`、`deterministic_check`、`agent_instruction` 和 `intent`。MCP 可以登记元数据和读取预防记录，但只有人工调用的 CLI 能验证或激活；Web 预防统计只读。

激活只记录证据，**不会**安装 CI 任务或宿主 Hook、编辑文件或执行 Git 写操作。状态规则、指标、隐私和故障排查见 [`docs/prevention.zh-CN.md`](docs/prevention.zh-CN.md)。

dsh-errkb README · 隐私与运行边界：- 知识保存在本机。核心不调用模型、不发起外网请求，也不上报遥测。
- 写库前完成脱敏。HTTP 默认关闭；MCP 使用 stdio，本地 API 使用仅所有者访问的 Named Pipe。
- 预防存储只包含元数据、哈希和有界脱敏证据，不包含产物正文或仓库绝对路径。
- 保留函数和设置已经存在，但后台服务尚未接入自动定时清理。
- DSH 适配器离线队列可能在核心脱敏前，暂时把原始观测保存在本机磁盘。

存储敏感项目数据前请阅读 [`docs/privacy.zh-CN.md`](docs/privacy.zh-CN.md)。

dsh-errkb README · 当前限制：- 必须安装 PostgreSQL 16；errkb 不是内嵌数据库的单文件应用。
- 发布物未做代码签名，请核对发布页的 `SHA256SUMS`。
- 预防产物激活不会自动把它接入 CI 或宿主工作流。
- errkb 不生成回归测试、不编辑预防文件、不自动写入 Git，也不自动执行检索到的修复。
- 不提供团队/云同步、向量检索、私有思维链采集或可靠的幻觉检测。
- 通用日志/手工宿主验收，以及连接器矩阵中明确标为未验证的路径仍未完成。
